m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited global doctrine (global-crew.md, global-everyone.md), plus docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md and GLOSSARY.md if present, plus the handoff at .agent-work/644-physics-fit-headless-hang/crew-handoffs/g1-implement-handoff.md. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff loaded; handoff complete

m1-guard.title: Add thread-cap guard to src/physics/__init__.py
m1-guard.imperative: Insert the thread-cap guard block at the very top of src/physics/__init__.py, before the module docstring's existing submodule imports, mirroring src/evo_predictor/run.py:26-38 exactly: os.environ.setdefault for OMP_NUM_THREADS/MKL_NUM_THREADS/OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS/NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS, then a try/except Exception around `import torch; torch.set_num_threads(1)`. Only os/logging/torch imports for the guard itself (constraint:physics_region_no_evo_import). Attest c1 that the guard precedes every existing `from src.physics.<submodule> import` line.

postconditions.statement: guard block precedes all existing submodule imports in __init__.py; setdefault (not hard assign) used for all 4 env vars; torch cap unconditional in try/except

constraints: no gating on sys.stdout.isatty() or any other conditional

m2-test.title: Add regression test mirroring #623's test
m2-test.imperative: Create tests/unit/physics/test_physics_init_thread_cap.py mirroring tests/unit/evo_predictor/test_run_entrypoint_thread_cap.py almost verbatim (same two assertions, same plain-import-no-reload rationale in the docstring) but importing src.physics instead of src.evo_predictor.run, with a docstring naming #644/#623 and the physics entrypoints this closes (scripts/nuisance_sensitivity.py, src/physics/session_fit.py load_quali_session, src/physics/layer2/estimate_store.py). Run it and attach the passing output to c2.

postconditions.statement: test file written, mirrors the #623 pattern

constraints: test-after allowed per handoff Test Mode (bounded env-var guard, not new business logic)

m3-suite.title: Full physics unit suite - no regression
m3-suite.imperative: Run the full tests/unit/physics suite and confirm no regression vs baseline (pre-existing failures, if any, are not this gate's to fix - note them honestly).

postconditions.statement: full physics unit suite passes (or pre-existing failures identified and not attributable to this change)

m4-repro-setup.title: Prepare empirical repro environment
m4-repro-setup.imperative: Identify the smallest real headless physics-fit call reachable in this worktree (scripts/nuisance_sensitivity.py needs data/telemetry + data/telemetry_store.db which are gitignored and absent from this worktree; wire read-only access to the main checkout's copies, e.g. a directory junction/copy of gitignored cache artifacts only - never a tracked repo file) and confirm it can run at all before attempting before/after timing. Attest c1 with what was set up and why.

postconditions.statement: repro command identified and its data dependencies satisfied (or documented as unreachable)

constraints: no changes to files outside Allowed Scope

m5-repro-before.title: BEFORE repro: does the unpatched entrypoint hang headless?
m5-repro-before.imperative: With the m1 guard temporarily removed (git stash the src/physics/__init__.py change, or run against the pre-fix content another way), run the repro command headless with a hard ~300s timeout, polling CPU to distinguish 0%-CPU deadlock from real progress. Restore the guard afterward. Attest c1 with the honest observation (hang reproduced / not reproduced in this shell - say so plainly either way).

postconditions.statement: before-fix observation recorded honestly (hang or no-hang), with transcript

m6-repro-after.title: AFTER repro: does the SAME command complete with the guard applied?
m6-repro-after.imperative: With the m1 guard restored, run the exact same repro command headless with the same ~300s timeout/CPU-polling discipline. Attest c1 with the honest verdict: reproduced-and-fixed / not-reproduced-here-but-fix-applied / still-hangs-after-fix. If still-hangs-after-fix, this is a STOP condition per the handoff - do not expand scope, report as blocker instead.

postconditions.statement: after-fix observation recorded honestly, with transcript and final verdict

constraints: do not fabricate a fix confirmation

m7-cleanup.title: Cleanup, evidence assembly, write result
m7-cleanup.imperative: Run git status; if the repro touched any data/*.db file, run git checkout -- data/ to discard it. Remove any temporary junction/copy created for repro. Confirm final git diff is scoped to src/physics/__init__.py and the new test file only. Write the full IMPLEMENTER_RESULT to .agent-work/644-physics-fit-headless-hang/crew-handoffs/g1-implement-result.md. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: workspace clean of repro side-effects; diff scoped; result file written

constraints: no data/*.db committed or left modified
